messages:
grace.sales: Handing off Skyline Health 	60% signed MSA today. Needs: private deploy (US-WEST), Okta SSO, 90-day pilot with a step-up to Dedicated after success. Pilot expected ~3-4k tokens/day, spike 25k on ramp. Renewal target 2026-07; customer hinted at vendor consolidation in ~10 months.

diego.csm: Thanks Grace. Owners: Diego (CSM), Sumi (Support), Oliver (Eng). Grace, can you drop infra contact and where creds are stored? Any billing credits?

grace.sales: Infra lead is tom@skyline.health. Creds in 1Password item Skyline-Provision-1739. Finance approved 45-day pilot credit; will forward signed note.

diego.csm: Drafting kickoff and Day0 checklist. Proposed pilot success metrics: p95 < 300ms, <2% classification drift, uptime >= 99.5. I'll set Account Health = onboarding: in progress and Renewal Watch = medium.

sumi.support: Opening triage ticket SUP-8344, runbook items: Okta metadata import, SAML smoke, cert exchange, firewall allowlist, KV warm-up. Will attach dashboard stub for token usage and latency. ETA ticket today.

oliver.eng: For private deploy need CIDR and KMS ARN from Tom. Proposed smoke test window 2024-05-20 09:00 PT. Will create RFC-2201 for private deploy checklist and quant validation (low effort).

diego.csm: Action items (short):
- Diego: kickoff invite, collate docs, success metrics, QBR cadence
- Sumi: SUP-8344 ticket + runbook + dashboard (ETA 1 day)
- Oliver: RFC-2201 + schedule provisioning once CIDR/KMS available
- Grace: send signed credit email and intro to Tom (ETA EOD)

grace.sales: Sent signed credit confirmation to finance and cc'd Diego: "45-day pilot credit up to $1,500". Intro to Tom sent.

sumi.support: SUP-8344 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-8344  attachments: onboarding-checklist.md. Added alerts: p95 > 350ms and route-error-rate > 1%.

oliver.eng: Provisioning queued (infra-5012) once Tom provides CIDR/KMS. Will run canary during smoke test and escalate to #eng-oncall if failures.

diego.csm: Noted renewal risk: set reminder for quarterly check-ins and product adoption dashboard. Also capturing customer feedback ask: they want a short enablement session for their ML team next week 	60m. Grace please confirm product owner availability.

grace.sales: Confirmed PO session available next Tue. CC'd PO in invite.

diego.csm: Closing loop for now. Next sync after smoke test. Escalate in #eng-oncall and tag @oliver.eng if blocked. :white_check_mark:
